purpose: User-directed one-species field identification and photo-comparison publication to GitHub Pages; do not change automated worker schedules.
user_requested: Finish whorled pennywort as the companion to dollarweed, verify the main look-alikes and reproductive keys, install legally reusable photos, annotate accurately, then publish.

photos.original_license: Ton Rulkens CC BY-SA 2.0 photo preserved without modification
photos.new_license: Five individually photo-licensed Texas iNaturalist research-grade sources, photo license cc-by, exact license version not independently asserted
photos.installed_image_sanity: GitHub Action verified six real JPEG files
photos.annotation_review: SHA-matched source original used to draw two arrows, full-size readback manually confirmed both landing on actual separated flower/fruit tiers.
limitations: No independent expert-vouchered H. verticillata vs H. bonariensis differentiation on installed iNaturalist images
Leaf underside with centrally peltate petiole insertion and a scaled mature mericarp macro still missing

taxonomy.accepted_species: Kew POWO accepts H. verticillata Thunb., Araliaceae, state-level Texas native
taxonomy.material_exception: Kew POWO currently maps historical H. verticillata var. triradiata (A.Rich.) Fernald to H. bonariensis whereas UT Williamson descriptions use H. verticillata var. triradiata. Keep explicit taxonomy HOLD. Do not silently merge.
taxonomy.county_range: BONAP target county status still UNRESOLVED and metrics excluded
taxonomy.plant_id_rule: Suitable for teaching genus-level whorls and distinguish from crowded H. umbellata, but not a claim of secure species ID for ambiguous historical triradiata collections.

publish_policy: Public rights-filtered GitHub Pages only. Cloudflare disabled, no new recurring automations. Do not claim website live until deployment succeeds.
